title: Path traversal in theme background delete: any user can delete arbitrary writable files
evidence: code review + probes by the admin test agent
test: to be written with the fix
cause: server/routes/themes.ts:136-158 only checks the 'theme-bg-' prefix, then path.join('./uploads', fileRef) + unlinkSync; '%2F' is decoded in params; no owner check
fix: Accept only ^theme-bg-[\w-]+\.(png|jpe?g|gif|webp)$, verify the resolved path is inside uploads, check ownership (a theme of the caller references it)

title: Anyone who can see a ticket can edit/delete any ticket comment (incl. other users' and internal ones)

fix: Require author or owner, and that the comment belongs to :id
